latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the self-improvement skill for OpenClaw and general coding agent use.

- Provides a rigorous framework for logging errors, learnings, and feature requests via markdown files for continuous improvement.
- Includes clear instructions and templates for LEARNINGS.md, ERRORS.md, and FEATURE_REQUESTS.md, with canonical entry formats and metadata.
- Defines workflow for reviewing, promoting, and resolving logged learnings—enabling upgrades to project-level memory files (AGENTS.md, SOUL.md, TOOLS.md, etc.).
- Supports integration with OpenClaw workspaces (with setup steps, promotion targets, and recommended hooks), but usable in other agent setups.
- Enables cross-session learning sharing, tracking of recurring patterns, and centralized project memory for best practices and fixes.
